images.after: How to disclose affiliate links in a video
images.title: Disclosing affiliate links in a video
images.alt: Steps to disclose YouTube affiliate links: say it early, show it on screen, repeat it by the link and tick the paid promotion option.
images.caption: Some people watch without sound and others listen without watching, so cover both.

items.title: Say it early
items.text: In plain words: you earn a commission if viewers buy through the links.

items.title: Show it on screen
items.text: Put the same sentence on screen for a few seconds while you say it.

items.title: Repeat it in the description
items.text: Place it right next to the link.

items.title: Tick paid promotion
items.text: Select the option in video details; it adds a label at the start.

items.title: Keep your own disclosure
items.text: The YouTube label doesn't replace what you say and show.

images.after: Where to put the links and what to say on camera
images.title: Where the link fits in a video
images.alt: Flow of an affiliate tutorial video: state the outcome, disclose and mention the link once, solve the problem, point to the link at the end.
images.caption: Repeated pitching is the quickest way to lose a viewer who came for instructions.

items.label: First few seconds
items.text: Say what the viewer will be able to do by the end

items.label: Mention the link once
items.text: Say it's linked below, along with the disclosure

items.label: Solve the problem
items.text: Spend the rest of the video on the task

items.label: Near the end
items.text: Point to the link again in one sentence
